notes: Strong T1 (Maintenance Access + two R&D steals) but spent 5 on Carmen and sat at 0-3 credits for many turns; T3 Window of Opportunity into Server 1 at 0 credits just ate a Ping tag. At 6 points from T6, the runner spent T10-T11 drawing, installing Sang Kancil and clicking credits (up to 11 credits) instead of running HQ/R&D or the advanced Server 1 card, and the Corp scored Witch Hunt from it on T12 to win.

Iced the remote and HQ first and left R&D open T1-T3 (Sericulture Expansion stolen T2), then the fast advances left it at 0 credits from T3 to T7. From T8 to T12 it clicked for credits at 10-15 credits with a full hand before scoring Flower Sermon (T14) and Yagi-Uda (T15). It won mainly because the Runner went passive.

Won, but mostly through Corp mistakes: from T4 on it made four R&D runs per turn (T4, T5, T7, T10), seeing the same top card again and again. It sat at 0-2 credits with 3 cards all game and never drew or built economy after Buzzsaw. Steals (Above the Law T1, Divested Trust T2, Transport Monopoly T8, Above the Law T11) came from naked or weak servers.

Used Ansel 1.0's install sub to trash its own ice: both ice on Server 1 on T8 and Vertigo+Hagen on Server 2 on T9, and both Project Ingatans were stolen right after. It then churned Server 2's ice through Ansel every run, paying 1-2 credits each time. From T13 to T26 it sat at 0 credits clicking for credits and discarding, never scored, and lost to a third Ingatan stolen from HQ.

Ran into the known, rezzed Ping with no way to break it about ten times (HQ T3/T4/T6/T10/T13/T14, Server 1 T8/T9/T11/T12) and wasted Maintenance Access by jacking out on T11. Its tags were punished by Behold! and Witch Hunt. It eventually won after Laser Pointer, Tremolo and Sang Kancil, stealing Witch Hunt (T16) and Freedom of Information (T19).

Put four ice on Server 1 (T1/T4/T7/T8) and never installed anything in it. Agendas piled up in HQ behind a single Hagen: Méliès City Luxury Line was stolen T6, Megaprix T10 and Architect Deployment Test T12. On T11-T12 it clicked for credits at 11-14 credits with 6 cards, discarding, and never scored a point.

Steady R&D pressure won it, but it took a Funhouse tag on almost every run from T5 to T16 and almost never cleared them. That let the Corp play Backroom Machinations twice (T11, T13) and trash Telework Contract. It installed Dr. Nuka Vrolyck (T9) and Beatriz (T11) while tagged, and both were trashed at once; the T6 Simulchip swap of Unity was pointless.

Ran R&D through the known Hammer four times on both T4 and T5 at 0 credits, taking a tag each time and re-accessing the same top card. It never drew past 3 cards and stayed at 0-2 credits, and the piled-up tags let Retribution trash Buzzsaw (T10). It never contested Server 1 after T1 while the Corp scored Transport Monopoly, Divested Trust and two Above the Laws from it.

Built a three-ice Server 2 (T3-T4) and iced Server 1 (T5) but never installed an agenda in either. It kept clicking to draw (T3, T6, T7), which filled HQ, protected only by Anemone, with See How They Run, Lotus Haze, Sisyphus Protocol and Hybrid Release, and all four were stolen by T8.

Sensible early remote scoring (Longevity Serum T3, Lotus Haze T6). From T9 to T14 it stalled, clicking for credits at 10-15 credits with a full hand and discarding on T11 and T14, before scoring Hybrid Release (T13) and Longevity Serum (T18). Single-ice R&D let Hybrid Release be stolen on T7.

Never put ice on R&D while the Runner ran it every turn and stole Embedded Reporting x2, Tomorrow's Headline and Next Big Thing by T4. It sat on 11-13 credits clicking for credits and played Oppo Research twice (T2, T4, even paying 5 for extra tags) without ever punishing the tags.

Solid econ (Strike Fund, Sure Gamble, Wildcat Strike, Raindrops Cut Stone) and well-timed R&D pressure (Divested Trust and Above the Law T3, Transport Monopoly T5), finishing with Buzzsaw into HQ for SDS Drone Deployment on T8. Its only clear miss was having no barrier answer, so Transport Monopoly was scored from Server 1 on T4 unchallenged.

Rezzed Grubber T1 for its last 5 credits and then left Embedded Reporting un-advanced in Server 1 behind a lone Ping from T2 to T4. It also put a second Post-Truth Dividend behind a single Ping in Server 2, and Gauss took both on T4. On T5-T9 it clicked for credits and discarded, then Tomorrow's Headline (T10) and Next Big Thing were stolen through ice the Runner could get past.

Made repeated runs on unrefreshed R&D, re-accessing the same top card (T1 x3, T3 x4), and never contested the remote while the Corp scored Yagi-Uda, Longevity Serum and two Hybrid Releases. With the Corp on 6 points and a card installed in Server 1, it spent all of T12 and T13 clicking for credits at 19-27 credits, and Regenesis was scored on T14 to lose.

Aggressive and effective early (Longevity Serum and Hybrid Release T1, Yagi-Uda T3, Hybrid Release from Archives T4), but at 6 points it took seven turns to find the last point. It spent T5-T10 on setup (double Daily Casts, Lie Low, Swift, two Blueberry Diesel, Info Bounty) with up to 15 credits instead of running, and let Regenesis be scored T6.

Spent 7 on Hagen T1 and was broke from then on, so Méliès (installed by Drafter into Server 1) was stolen T3 past unrezzable ice. From T4 to T12 it installed and rezzed Nico Campaigns in naked remotes every turn (2 credits each), and the Runner trashed every one for 2. With only Drafter on R&D, two Megaprix Qualifiers were stolen on T12.

Good HQ pressure with Boi-tatá on Ballista, plus Buzzsaw used for SDS Drone Deployment on T8 (bounced by Divested Trust, which was bad luck). It was oddly passive on T2 and T6, clicking for credits at 12-15 credits while the Corp was broke, and it never contested Above the Law in Server 1 (scored T10).

Put two ice on Server 1 (T2-T3) but never installed an agenda there. Cultivate (T2) and the end-of-turn discard (T5) both sent Hybrid Release into unprotected Archives, and both were stolen. Neurospike on T2 did nothing for 3 credits, and on T4-T7 it clicked for credits while Yagi-Uda sat in HQ behind unrezzed ice and was stolen T3.

Slow start: it clicked for credits on T2 at 9 credits and left R&D thin, so Architect Deployment Test was stolen twice on T3, and the remote it built on T3 stayed empty until T8. When it did install, Project Ingatan behind Vertigo and Wave (no ETR) was stolen at once. It recovered with Ansel on Server 1 and Seamless Launch to score Méliès and two Ingatans.

After T10 it did nothing but click for credits for about 18 turns, banking up to 82 credits. Its few runs ended because it would not pay Paywall's 1 credit (T9 with 6 credits, T25 with 68) or Grubber's 3 (T12 with 27), and Capacitor ended T20. Meanwhile the Corp scored Oracle Thinktank, Artificial Cryptocrash, Kingmaking and more out of reachable remotes.
